The fields of every model except `Document`, which has its own page. Every model can be described in code with `describe()`.

## Journal

Packaged; searched in Python. Identified by `abbreviation`.

| Field | Type | Match | Notes | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `abbreviation` | `str` | keyword |  | ADS abbreviation of the journal (its bibstem), e.g. 'ApJ'. This is the journal part of a bibcode, without the padding dots. |
| `title` | `str` | keyword |  | Full title of the journal, e.g. 'The Astrophysical Journal'. |

## Affiliation

Packaged; searched in Python. Identified by `id`.

| Field | Type | Match | Notes | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `str` | keyword |  | ADS canonical affiliation identifier, e.g. 'A00211'. |
| `abbreviation` | `str` | keyword |  | Short name of the institution, e.g. 'Harvard U'. |
| `canonical_name` | `str` | keyword |  | Full canonical name, e.g. 'Harvard University, Massachusetts'. |
| `country` | `str` | keyword |  | Country of the institution, spelled out as the upstream data spells it (e.g. 'United States', 'United Kingdom'), or None if not known. Spellings may change between data releases: filter on country_code for a stable condition. |
| `country_code` | `str` | keyword |  | ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country as the upstream data gives it (e.g. 'US', 'GB', 'AU'), or None if not known (also with data in the older layout, which has no codes). The stable way to filter by country. |
| `parent_ids` | `list[str]` | keyword |  | Identifiers of the parent institutions, in data-file order (empty for a top-level one). |

## UATConcept

Downloaded with `data.refresh("uat")`; searched in Python. Identified by `id`.

| Field | Type | Match | Notes | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `int` | keyword |  | UAT concept number, e.g. 486; SciX stores these in uat_id. |
| `name` | `str` | text |  | Preferred name of the concept, e.g. 'Exoplanets'. |
| `alt_names` | `list[str]` | text |  | Alternative names (synonyms) of the concept. |
| `parent_ids` | `list[int]` | keyword |  | Numbers of the broader concepts, in data-file order (empty for a top-level concept). |
| `uri` | `str` | keyword |  | URI of the concept, e.g. 'http://astrothesaurus.org/uat/486'. |
| `deprecated` | `bool` | keyword |  | Whether the concept has been withdrawn from the thesaurus. |

## PlanetaryFeature

Downloaded with `data.refresh("planetary_features")`; searched in Python. Identified by `id`.

| Field | Type | Match | Notes | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `int` | keyword |  | Gazetteer feature id, e.g. 2071; SciX stores these in planetary_feature_id. |
| `name` | `str` | text |  | Name of the feature without diacritics (the gazetteer's 'clean' name), e.g. 'Gale'. |
| `target` | `str` | keyword |  | The body the feature is on, e.g. 'Mars' or 'Moon'. |
| `feature_type` | `str` | keyword |  | Descriptor term, singular, e.g. 'Crater' or 'Mons' (the gazetteer's 'Crater, craters' without the plural), or a category such as 'Satellite Feature'. |
| `approval_status` | `str` | keyword |  | IAU status of the name: 'Approved', 'Dropped' or 'Not Approved'. |
| `approval_year` | `int` | keyword |  | Year the IAU approved the name, or None if not given. |

## Library

Your SciX libraries: fetched from SciX, then filtered in Python. Identified by `id`.

| Field | Type | Match | Notes | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `str` | keyword |  | Unique identifier of the library, assigned by ADS. |
| `name` | `str` | keyword |  | Name of the library (unique among its owner's libraries). |
| `description` | `str` | keyword |  | Description of the library. |
| `public` | `bool` | keyword |  | Whether anyone may read the library. |
| `owner` | `str` | keyword |  | ADS username of the owner (not their email address). |
| `permission` | `str` | keyword |  | Your own access level: 'owner', 'admin', 'write' or 'read'. |
| `num_documents` | `int` | keyword |  | Number of documents in the library. |
| `num_users` | `int` | keyword |  | Number of users with access to the library. |
| `date_created` | `datetime` | keyword |  | When the library was created (UTC). |
| `date_last_modified` | `datetime` | keyword |  | When the library was last modified (UTC). |

## Author

One author of a document, from `doc.authors`; used inside `Document.authors.any(...)` and `.all(...)`.

| Field | Type | Match | Notes | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `position` | `int` | keyword |  | The author's 0-based position in the document's author list. |
| `name` | `str` | name |  | The author's name, 'Lastname, First M' (from Document.author). |
| `aff` | `str` | text |  | The raw affiliation string as given (from Document.aff), or None. |
| `aff_id` | `list[str]` | keyword |  | Curated affiliation identifiers (from Document.aff_id, split on ';'); empty if there are none. |
| `email` | `str` | text |  | The author's email address (from Document.email), or None. |
| `orcid_pub` | `str` | text |  | ORCID supplied by the publisher (from Document.orcid_pub), or None. |
| `orcid_user` | `str` | text |  | ORCID claimed by a user who gave ADS consent to expose their profile (from Document.orcid_user), or None. |
| `orcid_other` | `str` | text |  | ORCID claimed with the ADS claiming interface (from Document.orcid_other), or None. |
| `orcid` | `str` | keyword |  | The author's ORCID from any source: the first of orcid_pub, orcid_user and orcid_other that is given (searched with Document.orcid). |

| Relation | Related model | Through | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `affiliation` | `Affiliation` | `aff_id` → `id` | The author's curated affiliations, from aff_id (possibly several; ids missing from the packaged data are skipped). |
